lines.text: After three days in Jerusalem, Nehemiah went out at night and inspected the broken walls and burned gates.
At the Fountain Gate there was no room for his animal, so Nehemiah went up the valley and inspected.
Nehemiah told the people to rebuild the wall of Jerusalem, and they set their hands to the good work.
Sanballat, Tobiah and Geshem mocked the builders, and Nehemiah said the God of Egypt would grant them success.
Eliashib and the priests began rebuilding at the Fish Gate, and Shallum's daughters helped him repair the wall.
